title: A sign-in return that is not completed opens as a guest with no message
evidence: claimRedirectCode (widget-src/src/storage/pkce.ts) and both adapters' code exchanges raise SignInUnfinishedError when a log-off came since the sign-in began; resolveBackend (widget-src/standalone/resolve-backend.ts) shows SIGN_IN_UNFINISHED, 'Sign-in did not finish. Your data stays in this browser.', in the connect notice, unreported (US-09 AC60; words Brad 2026-11-26). The did-not-connect line was not used: its 'so nothing changed' need not hold after a log-off.
